name: manual_78ee5a
claim: In Python the sqlite3 connection context manager commits but does not close; use contextlib.closing or a small close-always helper, and run new tests with warnings about unclosed resources treated as errors.

decisions.notes: 2026-10-19: six new tests left about 50 ResourceWarnings in the full run; a close-always helper removed them and the new tests pass with ResourceWarning as an error.
